batch: Phase B5 -- T2's own 401-verb pool, screened the same way as B1-B3 but with an added distinction this pool needed: stative 'be X' predications (138 of 401) are NOT operations and stay excluded, separate from genuine action verbs
method_note: Corrected two more keyword-matching errors found this round, disclosed not hidden: (1) 'to lie down' (recline/sleep) matched the M14 'lie' (deceive) keyword -- a genuine English homonym trap, 4 items corrected back to T3. (2) my own quick sub-scan of the be-state pool used speculative keywords ('refined', 'moist', 'appalled', 'loathsome') without verse-context confirmation -- none of those were included; only 4 clear, unambiguous physical-ailment matches (leprous/numb/feverish/epileptic) went to M73. 13 pure copulas (to be/be able/etc.) and 134 other stative 'be X' predications (be old/dark/hungry/drunk/beautiful/etc.) are correctly left in T2, matching the existing precedent already set for 'to be' itself -- a state is not a movement.
